environment: Node.js GLTFLoader + actual corrected GLB and real calibrated paper; not physical shoe or Safari testing

checks.name: Static object paths, exact vertex/index fingerprints and barycentric anchors match actual GLTFLoader
Actual reference-point visibility and ray hits agree; occluded points remain null
Visible-cloth demonstration samples are explicitly separate from the eight installation references
Actual visible-shell subset retains original paper topology and restores flat display without drift

limitations: Photo registration and paper forming remain assumptions; numerical identity does not establish physical accuracy.
Only visible explicitly labelled cloth receives anchors; no hidden support cloth is fabricated.
Model units are not independently calibrated millimetres.
Linear shell interpolation is correspondence display, not a reconstructed sewing process.
